definitions.explanation: The flat area on each side of the head between the forehead and the ear.

examples.japanese: こめかみを{押|お}さえる。
こめかみに{白髪|しらが}が{生|は}えてきた。
examples.english: Gray hair has started to grow at my temples.

notes:
こめかみ refers to the flat area on each side of the head between the forehead and the ear. Usually written in hiragana; the kanji {米噛|こめかみ} exists but is rarely used.

ETYMOLOGY:
The name likely comes from the motion of this area when chewing rice ({米|こめ}を{噛|か}む).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- こめかみが{痛|いた}い: to have pain in one's temples
- こめかみを{押|お}さえる: to press one's temples
- こめかみを{揉|も}む: to rub one's temples
- こめかみがズキズキする: to have a throbbing pain in one's temples

HEADACHE CONTEXT:
Often associated with tension headaches and migraines ({偏頭痛|へんずつう}). People commonly press or massage this area to relieve pain.

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- ひたい/{額|ひたい}: forehead
- ほほ/{頬|ほほ}: cheek
- {耳|みみ}: ear
